* Example 1:
[Input]
```INPUT_TEXT
Slide Title: Welcome to the presentation on how Google Cloud can help Tata Starbucks Private Limited enhance customer experience, revenue generation, and operational efficiency.
Slide Content: Google Cloud offers a comprehensive suite of services and capabilities that can benefit Tata Starbucks Private Limited, including:
- Application Modernization: Migrate and modernize your applications to the cloud to improve performance, scalability, and security.
- Data Management: Manage and analyze your data in the cloud to gain insights and make better decisions.
- Smart Analytics: Use machine learning and artificial intelligence to analyze your data and identify trends and patterns.
```
